description: Na₄CaNbSi₂PO₁₂ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-3.02 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.86 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.77 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.35 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.75 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.74 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-41°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
